Notes

A single 208 by 160 swatch is a small share of the page, so this one lands in the amber band rather than the red one. That is the intended reading: the score is a triage signal that tells you where to look, not a verdict on how bad the change is.

It still has to move. A recoloured element that scored as parity would mean the comparison was measuring layout instead of pixels.
